_doc: Verda list prices (USD, on-demand) read from https://verda.com/pricing on 2026-11-14 (Serverless containers table). Re-check in the console before any run; Junction credits are assumed to cover list prices.
billing_rule: Serverless Containers: billed for every minute in which a replica processed any usage, including spin-up/down (https://docs.verda.com/containers/overview/).
